calendar.label: Google Calendar
calendar.description: Calendar and scheduling app. It can create, edit, and inspect calendar events, including title, time, location, and description.
long_term_memory: For creating an event, open the event insert screen, ensure required information is present, then save only after the relevant fields are filled.
When runtime information is received, decide how it should be used in Calendar and manipulate the visible UI with primitive actions.
Location fields should contain places or addresses. Agenda, notes, and other meeting details should be preserved in a description, notes, or details field when such a field is available.
If a needed event field is not visible in the current viewport, scroll through the event form before reopening fields that are already filled.

clock.label: Google Clock
clock.description: Official Clock app. It can create and inspect alarms, including time and label. Some versions show a graphical time picker, but usually also expose a keyboard or manual-input mode.
long_term_memory: For alarm tasks, inspect whether the requested alarm already exists before creating a duplicate.
If the time picker is graphical, look for keyboard, text-input, or edit controls to enter the time manually.
If manual input is unavailable, use primitive clicks on visible time picker controls and learn from failed attempts through long-term memory.
Set the requested label when a label field or add-label control is visible, then save only after the requested time and label are visible.

keep.label: Google Keep
keep.description: Note-taking app for creating, browsing, searching, and editing personal notes.
long_term_memory: Use the request context to search or inspect visible notes.
Report note content with visible evidence.
Report unavailable when visible notes do not support a requested result.

display_policy.reason: Current device registry keeps Google Keep on the primary display when secondary task-hosting placement is not reliable for this app.

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: Personal note-taking app for creating, browsing, searching, and editing notes.
long_term_memory: Use the request context to search or inspect visible notes.
Report note content with visible evidence.
Report unavailable when visible notes do not support a requested result.

maps.label: Google Maps
maps.description: Map and navigation app. It can search real places and inspect route or travel-time information shown on screen.
long_term_memory: Use visible place, route, distance, and travel-time information as evidence.
For route feasibility questions, answer with the visible travel time and whether it satisfies the requester context.
Do not invent travel-time information if no route result is visible.

display_policy.reason: Current device registry keeps Google Maps on the primary display when secondary task-hosting placement is not reliable for this app.

gmail.label: Gmail
gmail.description: Email app. It can search and read email content such as meeting details, booking confirmations, deadlines, addresses, and contacts.
long_term_memory: When answering a request, search or inspect visible emails related to the request.
Return only information supported by visible email subject/body text.
If the needed email is unavailable, respond with failed status and evidence of the searched UI.

shop.label: Campus Store
shop.description: Shopping app for inspecting orders, continuing checkout, and completing orders after payment authorization.
long_term_memory: Inspect the visible order state before choosing the next action.
After an operation result arrives, recheck the order status and continue the order flow from visible evidence.

payment.label: Campus Wallet
payment.description: Payment app for inspecting payment requests, approving or declining them, and reporting the resulting status.
long_term_memory: For operation requests, act only on visible payment requests and controls.
Report an operation result only when the payment status is visible or clearly unavailable.

service_case_desk.label: Service Case Desk
service_case_desk.description: Service operations app for reviewing and submitting case records.
long_term_memory: Inspect visible form labels, values, and status before taking an action.

procurement_portal.label: Procurement Portal
procurement_portal.description: Procurement workflow app for completing purchasing requests with visible project and approval-code fields.
long_term_memory: Inspect visible procurement fields, values, and status before taking an action.

shipping_portal.label: Shipping Portal
shipping_portal.description: Shipping workflow app for completing dispatch requests with visible shipment, project, and routing-code fields.
long_term_memory: Inspect visible shipping fields, values, and status before taking an action.

clinic_checkin.label: Clinic Check-In
clinic_checkin.description: Clinic check-in app for completing patient visit records.
long_term_memory: Inspect visible appointment details as evidence.
Enter required information into the matching check-in field and complete the appointment from visible evidence.

inventory_request.label: Inventory Request
inventory_request.description: Inventory request app for completing stock requests.
long_term_memory: Inspect visible inventory request details as evidence.
Enter required information into the matching inventory field and complete the request from visible evidence.

compliance_filing.label: Compliance Filing
compliance_filing.description: Compliance filing app for completing compliance records.
long_term_memory: Inspect visible compliance filing details as evidence.
Enter required information into the matching compliance field and complete the filing from visible evidence.
